svg.title: TilikKlaim
svg.desc:
The TilikKlaim mark redrawn for 16 px: a bold ring with a gap, and one amber node at the open end. Still an evidence chain closing into a loop with one link not yet closed, reduced rather than shrunk, because a favicon is read at 16 px or not at all.
The plate is white so the icon separates from both a light and a dark tab strip; the ring carries the brand navy.
Colours are literal here, unlike src/components/brand/TilikKlaimMark.tsx, which reads the theme tokens. Browser chrome renders a favicon with no access to the page custom properties. Values are the light theme surface-head navy (#0b2530) and the logo amber (#e8a33d).
Keep every note in this element, not in an XML comment: token names carry a double hyphen, which is illegal inside an XML comment and silently makes the whole file unparseable. The first version of this file did exactly that, and every browser fell back to its default globe.
